items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The quartet being Eternal Winds, which features ... Ralph Jones on woodwinds ... and myself.

ctx.x: Yeah. I, I think it was 1992 that I did for a quartet and orchestra. The quartet being Eternal Winds, which features Adam Rudolph on percussion, Ralph Jones on woodwinds, Charles Moore, trumpet, flugelhorn, and Frederico Ramos, guitar...and myself. Um...now this is in, in essence its a tone poem. This is a piece with an extra musical idea, and um the idea is that of reflecting um the epic uh historical factor or slavery. In fact, the first movement is entitled, what do you call it, The African As Non- American,…
It’s a beautiful, yeah, it’s a very beautiful piece.
